captions.detailed: A matte black, modern countertop air fryer with a vertical rectangular main body. It features a pullout lower basket drawer equipped with a small rectangular glass viewing window, a front handle, and a grey release button. The right side of the unit hosts a control interface consisting of two rotating cylindrical dials and three small rectangular push buttons. Articulated parts include the sliding drawer, the sliding handle release button, three independent push buttons, and two continuously rotating dials.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a countertop kitchen air fryer with a vertical main housing, a pullout basket drawer containing a viewing window, a front handle with a release button, and a right-side control interface with two dials and three push buttons. Ensure appropriate materials are assigned for the black housing, glass window, and grey buttons, and define joints for the sliding drawer, sliding release button, rotating dials, and plunging push buttons.
captions.factory: Construct the main body housing as a hollowed-out box with rounded vertical edges, cutouts for the internal cooking cavity, and side control holes. Model the drawer using a thin-walled box with a front handle and a transparent window pane. Create the control interface by adding cylindrical pins for the dials and small rectangular boxes for the push buttons. Assemble the parts using prismatic joints for the drawer, the handle release button, and the three push buttons, and continuous revolute joints for the two control dials.
